Sequence reader-widen (audit/page.py comparison) before emitter-change (contracts.py, schema, prompts) so 827 live legacy verdicts render identically when tag vocabulary shifts
Emit [non-codebase] exclusively in all author-facing surfaces and prompts while accepting both spellings in recognition; parametrize all suites to prove identical outcomes for both tag forms
Add ADR-0101 amending ADR-0043 to document the rename rationale, compatibility alias design, and rejection of [operator_attested] underscore form
